name: Market-mediated character officer supply
outcome: A receiver publishes a provider-neutral officer-supply lot, qualified providers compete, the Academy discloses the sovereign supplier contracts that make its bid feasible, and only the receiver may award and admit the resulting contract.
flow: receiver offers OfficerSupplyLot to an admitted market
Academy and other capable providers author competing bids
Academy recursively procures missing capacity from voluntary sovereign suppliers
receiver compares bids and may Accept, Reject, Question, or leave the lot open
winning provider fulfills the contract; receiver separately decides recognition and induction
academyBidRequires: exact office lot and receiver-local necessity
qualified character or an explicitly conditional formation plan
disclosed contribution, shortfall, authority, and refusal terms
no claim that bid, award, supply, or animation is appointment
recursiveImprovement: Supplier outcomes, refusals, witnessed execution, and receiver receipts enter the Academy's knowledge loop; the next cohort, repertoire epoch, provider configuration, and bid can improve independently without an imperial release line.
